subject: FlowOps onboarding: insurance packet and subcontractor disclosure
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@flowops.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@flowops.io>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FlowOps onboarding docs — COI, W-9, subcontractor list

Hi Hannah / Marcus,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get FlowOps set up with Redwood. Attached are the initial docs for vendor onboarding: certificate of insurance, W-9, subcontractor disclosure, and our recent claims summary. Please let me know if anything else is required to move to PO issuance.

Attachments:
- FlowOps_COI_2026-06.pdf (certificate of insurance, GL/PL limits)
- FlowOps_W9.pdf (tax form)
- FlowOps_Subcontractor_List.xlsx (3rd-party integrators we use)
- FlowOps_Claims_History.pdf (claims summary last 3 years)

A few notes from our broker: the COI currently lists limits of $1M CSL and names Redwood as "Certificate Holder". We can ask our broker to issue an Additional Insured endorsement if Redwood requires it — happy to coordinate.

Next steps we need: confirmation of any endorsement language or additional insured naming, PO reference to billing contact, and estimated timing for PO creation so we can plan go-live.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Head of Partnerships | FlowOps
[lisa.tran@flowops.io]

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@flowops.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FlowOps onboarding docs — COI, W-9, subcontractor list

Hi Lisa — thanks for sending these through and for the clear packet. Quick checklist from procurement/legal so we can greenlight the PO: 

1) Additional Insured endorsement: we require an Additional Insured endorsement naming Redwood Inference, Inc., 215 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94103, for General Liability and Completed Operations. Can your broker add Redwood as Additional Insured and send the endorsement PDF?

2) Waiver of subrogation/primary language: if possible, please confirm the COI/endurance shows primary/non-contributory wording for GL where allowed.

3) Subcontractors: thanks for the list — we need a signed subcontractor attestation (one-page) confirming FlowOps retains responsibility for subcontractor performance and that subcontractors carry minimum GL limits of $1M each.

4) W-9 received — thank you.

5) Claims summary: we will review; if there are open claims that would affect underwriting, procurement/legal will follow up.

I'll ask procurement to place a conditional PO hold until the Additional Insured endorsement and the subcontractor attestation are provided. Marcus, can you confirm the PO timing once docs are in? Marissa — tagging you for legal acceptance of the endorsement language.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com]

---

From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@flowops.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@flowops.io>, Acuity Broker <broker@acuity-ins.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FlowOps onboarding docs — COI, W-9, subcontractor list

Hi Hannah — appreciate the checklist. I looped in our broker and procurement. A couple of updates:

- Broker note: they can issue the Additional Insured endorsement; I attached a draft endorsement to this email for your review. It names Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured but the draft uses our broker's standard text — happy to accept edits if you need specific language.
- The COI does not currently include "primary/non-contributory" language due to our umbrella policy structure, but Acuity says they can add clarifying language where permitted.
- Subcontractor attestation: attaching a one-page signed attestation for the 3 subcontractors listed.

Attachments:
- FlowOps_Endorsement_Draft.pdf (draft Additional Insured endorsement from Acuity)
- FlowOps_Subcontractor_Attestation.pdf (signed attestation)

Let me know if the endorsement PDF is acceptable or if you need the broker to issue a revised PDF naming Redwood exactly as in your address block.

Thanks,
Lisa

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@flowops.io>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FlowOps onboarding docs — COI, W-9, subcontractor list

Hi Lisa — thanks, this is moving in the right direction. A few procurement notes so timelines are clear: 

- We can create a conditional PO (PO-REQ# 2026-FO-1123) within 2 business days of receiving the finalized Additional Insured endorsement PDF that explicitly names "Redwood Inference, Inc., 215 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94103".
- If the endorsement language includes "primary/non-contributory" that will speed legal review; otherwise legal may take an extra 3–5 business days.
- Please confirm billing contact and invoice remittance address for the PO (we typically require a billing email + EIN on the W-9 matches vendor profile).

Marissa — can legal confirm whether the draft endorsement in FlowOps_Endorsement_Draft.pdf is acceptable as-is or whether we need a redline to the broker?

Once endorsement + attestation + W-9 are in good order, I'll mark the vendor as "Approved Pending PO" and route to Finance for PO issuance.

Thanks,
Marcus
Procurement | Redwood Inference
[marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com]

From: Acuity Broker <broker@acuity-ins.com>

Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FlowOps onboarding docs — COI, W-9, subcontractor list

Marcus / Hannah / Lisa — attaching the finalized Additional Insured endorsement PDF. It names
"Redwood Inference, Inc., 215 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA 94103" as Additional Insured for General Liability and Completed Operations. The endorsement includes the following key language:

- Additional Insured for ongoing operations and completed operations of the named insured.
- Waiver of subrogation: not provided for workers' compensation (per state constraints) but GL primary/non-contributory language included.

Attachments:
- FlowOps_Endorsement_Final.pdf (endorsement, 1 page)

If procurement/legal confirm acceptance we can proceed to have Finance issue the PO.

Best,
Acuity Broker
Acuity Insurance Brokers

Subject: Re: FlowOps onboarding docs — COI, W-9, subcontractor list

Hi all — received the finalized endorsement from Acuity. Marissa: legal reviewed and confirmed the endorsement language satisfies our Additional Insured and primary/non-contributory requirements for the GL line. Minor note: we still need the subcontractor attestation in Excel (the PDF is fine for now but procurement prefers a structured XLSX for our records). Lisa — can you resend the attestation in XLSX?

Marcus: once FlowOps sends the attestation XLSX, please move forward with PO issuance (reference PO-REQ# 2026-FO-1123). Vendor onboarding team will set activation date once PO is in Financials.

Lisa — welcome aboard, excited to kick this off.

Thanks,
Hannah
Senior Manager, Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
